    How will you pay?

    Place your order first, then pay right away. The next screen (and your email) shows your order number and payment details.     Helps Pasha find your payment if the order number is missing from the note.

    Please read before ordering

    Pashabakess is not allergen-free. The cookies are not free of peanuts, tree nuts, gluten, dairy/eggs, soy, or food coloring, so they are not suitable for peanut, tree nut, gluten, dairy/egg, soy, or food coloring allergies. Everything is prepared in the same kitchen using shared equipment, trays, utensils, and packaging areas. Because cross-contact can happen, Pasha does not recommend ordering or sharing the cookies with anyone who has food allergies.

    Cancellations & refunds

    Because every order is baked fresh, cookies can’t be returned or exchanged. To cancel or reschedule your pickup, email pashabakess@gmail.com at least two calendar days before your pickup date (for a Saturday pickup, by Thursday). With that notice you’ll receive a full refund to the Venmo or Cash App account you paid from, sent within 3–5 business days. Cancellations with less notice can’t be refunded.

    Missed pickups: you have two days after your pickup date to collect your order. Orders not picked up by then can’t be refunded. If Pasha has to cancel your order (for example, if your pickup date becomes fully booked), you’ll receive a full refund.

    Nothing is charged on this website. After you place your order, you’ll pay through Venmo using your order number, and Pasha confirms your order by email once your payment arrives.
